title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote Ireland)
description:
## About Us
Qualio is a unified quality and compliance management platform that helps regulated organizations get products to market faster with reduced risk. Trusted by biopharma, medtech, and diagnostics companies worldwide, Qualio eliminates fragmented systems that create audit delays and compliance blind spots. Our platform enables audit readiness in weeks through multi-standard automated gap analysis and evidence reuse across ISO and FDA requirements. Qualio is ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and ISO 27701 certified, reflecting our commitment to security, quality, and privacy.
The Qualio team is all-remote, and currently distributed across North America, Europe and Australia.
## Who are we?
At Qualio, the engineering department is responsible for the "what" and the "how". "What" as in what should we build for our customers. "How" as in how do we deliver and operate the solution.
We are working on building a platform team providing horizontal services to vertical feature centric product teams to deliver on Qualio's brand promise - "An easy, scalable and trusted QMS".
## How do we work?
We are designing our teams to own specific horizontal areas of our application. Teams are made up of a Product manager (PM), Engineering team lead and a team of engineers. Owning the area of application means everything, collaborating with product managers, customer success partners, architecture, peer engineering teams to deliver robust cloud-based solutions that drive powerful experiences to our customers.
As Werner Vogels says, "You build it, you run it".
## What do we value?
In order to make this a reality we value a number of things:
• Iterative development - Solutions are delivered as a collection of small pieces. No big bangs.
• Test driven development
• Clean code
• Automation in all its forms - tests, infrastructure, build and deploy - everything
• "Done" means it's in the hands of customers
## What’s the opportunity?
As Qualio continues to grow, we are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join one of our platform teams. We have a new feature area that is growing beyond an MVP.
We are predominantly a Python shop, but we also use Node.js, TypeScript, React, AngularJS, REST APIs and host our cloud software in AWS, but we’re open to developers who have expertise in different languages as long as you're open to learning!
## What will I be doing?
• Strong team player with a collaborative mindset
• Partner with team in designing, implementing and delivering effective cloud based solutions - evidenced by timeliness, quality, usability, operational stability, performance, and success of meeting customer requirements/business objectives
• Ability to maintain a proactive and positive attitude in a fast-paced, changing environment
• You like the sound of working for a fully remote-based organization with lots of opportunities
## What skills do I need?
• You have 3+ years of professional software development experience.
• Utilize programming languages like Python, Node.js, RDBMS and NoSQL databases.
• Well-versed with AWS Cloud based services such as ECS, Lambda, EC2, and related technologies e.g. ELB, API Gateway, Security groups, VPCs, etc
• Well-versed with OpenSearch
• You can code, conduct reviews on architecture and code along with other team members to build effective software
• Apply engineering best practices in TDD, clean code, CI/CD to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support product solutions
• Experience with Agile methodologies/DevSecOps environment
• Breadth and depth of experience in areas like application platforms, integration patterns, event-driven architecture, data management, and infrastructure as code
• Actively use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate your work, whether writing code, debugging, or prototyping, and you have a point of view on where AI helps and where it doesn't in an engineering context.
## Benefits
In addition to playing an important role in building Qualio, you'll receive:
• The opportunity in helping life-saving products get to market faster
• Private medical coverage (details vary by country)
• Flexible Time Off (FTO) policy: take time when you need it
• Generous one-time allowance for your home office setup
• Annual Learning & Development stipend
• Regular team gatherings and all-org meetups
## A note to candidates:
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they meet every single one of the qualifications as described in a job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive company and we are most interested in finding the BEST candidate for the job. That candidate may be one who comes from a less traditional background, and that’s okay. We would strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't believe you meet every one of the qualifications described.

Buscamos profesionales que quieran ayudarnos a responder una pregunta que cada vez más organizaciones se están haciendo:
¿Cómo debería rediseñarse una organización cuando la IA empieza a asumir parte del trabajo que hoy realizan las personas?
No buscamos simplemente implementar herramientas de IA. Buscamos entender cómo cambia el trabajo, qué tareas pueden automatizarse o aumentarse, qué capacidades necesitará la organización y cómo deberían evolucionar roles, equipos y estructuras.
## ¿Qué harás?
Participarás en proyectos relacionados con:
## AI Workforce Planning.
## Strategic Workforce Planning.
## Análisis de roles, tareas y capacidades.
Identificación de tareas automatizables, aumentables y humanas.
## Rediseño de puestos de trabajo.
## Organizational Design.
## Skills-Based Organizations.
## Workforce Transformation.
Identificación de nuevas capacidades necesarias por la incorporación de IA.
Diseño de escenarios futuros de workforce.
Acompañamiento a líderes y equipos durante procesos de transformación.
## Nos interesa especialmente conocerte si tienes experiencia en
People Strategy, HR Transformation, Strategic Workforce Planning, Organizational Design, People Analytics, Future of Work, Change Management o transformación organizativa.
No esperamos que una persona domine todas estas áreas.
Buscamos especialmente capacidad de análisis, curiosidad por la IA y una visión sistémica de las organizaciones.
## Sobre Ethikos
En Ethikos ayudamos a las organizaciones a evolucionar su sistema humano para adaptarse a una nueva realidad del trabajo.
Trabajamos sobre tres grandes dimensiones:
## Talento + Organización + Capacidades
Y estamos desarrollando una línea específica de AI Workforce Planning & Organizational Redesign para ayudar a las organizaciones a rediseñar el trabajo antes de limitarse a incorporar tecnología.
## ¿Por qué unirte?
Porque estamos entrando en un territorio que todavía se está construyendo.
Tendrás la oportunidad de participar en proyectos donde las preguntas todavía son más importantes que las respuestas.

title: Forensic Regulatory Data Analyst
description:
Forensic Regulatory Data Analyst – Utility Cost Recovery
UtiliSave's forensic billing analysts find actionable savings in 94% of the accounts they audit — including clients who were previously reviewed by another firm and believed nothing remained. If you have the instincts to absorb complex rules, spot the flaw no one else noticed, and relentlessly pursue a claim you know is right, you will thrive here.
Consider this: a large commercial building billed for peak electricity demand on the wrong interval meter. A university's water charges calculated under a rate code that hasn't applied to its account type for three years. A hospital's natural gas tariff with a weather normalization adjustment misapplied for 18 months. These are not hypotheticals — they are the types of claims our analysts have made, won, and been paid for. Join the team that has recovered over $700 million for large commercial and industrial clients across the U.S. and help us break through One Billion.
UtiliSave has been an industry leader in utility bill auditing services for over 35 years and is still growing rapidly. We are seeking curious, analytical action-takers with strong Python skills to join the team at the heart of our success — playing a key role in deep, forensic utility bill analysis for large commercial and industrial clients.
The core talent this role demands is the ability to rapidly absorb and master detailed billing rules, tariff schedules, demand charge structures, rider provisions, regulatory codes, and client usage data — and then deploy that knowledge creatively to find refunds and savings others miss. The ideal candidate thinks beyond established frameworks: constructing novel, sustainable claim theories that withstand regulatory scrutiny, and expressing those claims persuasively in writing and verbally to utilities, regulators, and clients.
On a typical day, you might write a Python script to flag demand charge anomalies across 40 accounts in the morning and draft a formal claim letter to a state utility commission in the afternoon. This is an ideal entry-level role for someone who wants to become an expert in a rare, financially consequential discipline and to see that expertise translates directly into personal earnings.
What You Will Build Here
UtiliSave is not a lateral move — it is a launchpad:
3–6 months: Generating your first confirmed refund claims on live client accounts, guided by senior analysts and our proprietary platform.
12–18 months: Independently managing a portfolio across multiple utility jurisdictions with a growing track record of recoveries.
24+ months: High performers advance to Senior Analyst, Practice Lead, or Client Relationship Manager — with expanded compensation and client ownership.
The expertise you build here — utility tariff law, regulatory billing, forensic financial analysis — is rare and directly monetizable. Few entry-level roles put this much earning power in your own hands this quickly.To apply, email your resume and optional cover letter to with the job title in the subject line. Please include your state of residence, work authorization status, and compensation expectations.
## Requirements
Please confirm you meet all the following before applying:
• Full-time remote; core hours 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time.
• Must reside in the Eastern Time Zone or Central Time Zone (Missouri, Arkansas, Mississippi, Alabama).
• U.S. Citizens and active Green Card holders only. Visa sponsorship is not available.
## · Python proficiency required.
Responsibilities
• Apply analytical skills and general business knowledge to identify cost savings using UtiliSave's proprietary tools and those you help build in real time — then initiate action to recover those savings for clients.
• Rapidly absorb and master the billing rules, tariff schedules, demand calculations, rider provisions, tax codes, and regulatory frameworks across each client's utility jurisdictions — using that knowledge to uncover billing errors, misapplied rates, and overlooked credits.
• Conduct retroactive audits across the full statute of limitations — often six years or more — to maximize the recoverable amount on every client account.
• Interface with clients, utility companies, tax authorities, and regulatory agencies to implement savings. When utilities dispute or delay valid claims, pursue every available administrative and regulatory channel until the matter is resolved. When escalation is warranted, coordinate with UtiliSave's outside utility-specialized law firm retained at no additional cost to clients to bring the full weight of the firm's resources to bear.
• Develop novel but defensible claim theories going beyond standard audit playbooks by combining deep tariff knowledge with creative pattern recognition across billing history, meter data, and account classifications.
• Draft clear, persuasive written claim submissions, client summaries, and regulatory correspondence that make complex billing issues accessible to non-technical readers.
• Pivot quickly across accounts, jurisdictions, and claim types as opportunities surface, deadlines shift, or utility responses require a change in approach.
• Maintain meticulous records of all open claims, supporting data, utility correspondence, and recovery outcomes from identification through payment.
• Collaborate with our MIS group to build tools that improve account review and drive revenue.
Requirements
• 1–3 years of experience — or equivalent academic, project, or internship work — demonstrating the ability to rapidly master complex rule-based systems (regulatory codes, tariff schedules, tax law, legal frameworks, accounting standards) and translate that mastery into actionable opportunities.
• Undergraduate degree completed (or within six months of completion). STEM, economics, finance, regulatory affairs, or pre-law preferred — but candidates from any field are welcome. What matters most: a proven ability to absorb dense, rule-laden material and apply it creatively. Strong hires have included engineers who spot meter anomalies, accountants who catch tax misclassifications, and economists who identify misapplied rate tiers.
• Proficiency in Python — used daily to extract, clean, and interrogate billing data and to automate anomaly detection across large client portfolios. UtiliSave has invested over $10 million in proprietary analytics infrastructure; your Python skills will extend these systems. Other languages a plus.
• Intellectually tenacious: you pursue a well-founded claim until it is resolved, do not accept a utility's first "no" as final, and find alternative angles when the obvious path is blocked.
• Creative and analytically precise: able to construct novel but technically sound claim theories that hold up under regulatory scrutiny — not just surface-level billing corrections.
• Strong written and oral communicator: persuasive claim letters, client reports, and regulatory filings on the written side; confident presenting findings to utility representatives, regulators, and senior client personnel verbally.
• Comfortable with ambiguity: utility tariff language is often dense, contradictory, or silent on the precise situation. The best analysts are energized by that gap — because it is often where the opportunity lives.
• Agile: able to shift rapidly between accounts, jurisdictions, and issue types without losing precision or momentum.
• Experience with a regulated public utility — especially in rate billing analysis or customer interaction — is a material advantage.
• Ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.
Additional Information
• Training: New analysts complete a paid three-month intensive onboarding process, one of the most comprehensive programs in the utility auditing industry. It is a paid apprenticeship in one of the most arcane and financially valuable corners of regulatory billing law. The pipeline is rigorous by design: every claim we make must be technically sound and built to withstand utility scrutiny. Analysts who commit fully emerge with a rare, market-differentiated skill set.
Growth: High-performing analysts have advanced to Senior Analyst, Practice Lead, and Client Relationship Manager within two to three years.
## Benefits
## Compensation & Benefits:
o Base: $40,000/year, increasing to $45,000 upon successful completion of auditing skills benchmarks
o Monthly performance bonus beginning after onboarding completion: UtiliSave's bonus is tied directly to the refund and savings claims you generate. Successful established analysts regularly earn $1,000–$3,000+ per month in bonuses — bringing total annual compensation for strong performers to $55,000–$76,000 or more. Earning potential grows directly with the depth of your knowledge and the creativity of your claims.
o Health, dental, and vision insurance
## o 401(k) with company match
## o 3 weeks PTO plus 11 paid holidays
## o Full-time remote

title: Product Owner, AI Pod
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical Product Owner (Contractor) for two AI Pods that build the foundations of Numa, Enumerate’s AI product line, including Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist. This role is focused on execution, not product strategy or roadmap direction. The Product Owner will own and detail the AI Pod backlog, lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for every release, document test findings clearly, and analyze customer usage and metrics to inform what gets built next. The role reports to the Director of Product Management and works closely with Product Managers and Engineering. This is a strong fit for someone with a QA background who has recently moved into a product role and wants to grow in product management working on live, customer-facing AI products.
This is a remote contractor opportunity for candidates located in LATAM who are comfortable working in an English-speaking professional environment.
Key Responsibilities
Backlog Ownership & Agile Execution
• Own, detail, and manage the delivery backlog for the two AI Pod teams
• Translate defined product priorities into detailed user stories, functional requirements, and testable acceptance criteria
• Break down initiatives into well-scoped epics, stories, and tasks with clear definitions of ready and done
• Keep backlog items refined, prioritized, and ready for development ahead of each sprint
• Work with other Product Managers and Product Owners whose features depend on the AI Pods to validate requirements and sign-off
• Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives
• Partner with Engineering to clarify scope, remove blockers, and escalate dependencies and risks
User Acceptance Testing & Quality Validation
• Plan and conduct UAT for AI Pod deliverables and provide release sign-off
• Create and maintain UAT plans, test scenarios, and test cases tied to acceptance criteria
• Perform functional, regression, and edge-case testing on completed stories and features before release
• Validate AI output quality for Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist, including accuracy, relevance, consistency, and exception handling, using repeatable test prompts and evaluation sets
• Log, document, and prioritize defects, and verify fixes before closing
Documentation of Findings
• Document UAT results, defects, and AI output evaluation findings in a clear, structured, repeatable format
• Produce release-level test summaries covering what was tested, results, known issues, and recommended follow-ups
• Maintain up-to-date user stories, acceptance criteria, test cases, and supporting documentation
• Provide Product Marketing with feature details and release information needed for go-to-market materials
Customer Usage & Metrics Analysis
• Own product analytics for Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist, including adoption, usage, and engagement metrics
• Analyze usage patterns, customer questions, and feedback to identify friction points, gaps in AI responses, and improvement opportunities
• Build and maintain recurring usage and metrics reporting for product leadership
• Turn findings into backlog items and use data to inform prioritization
AI & Automation Workflow Enablement
• Analyze and document end-to-end workflows suitable for AI-driven automation
• Turn tasks users currently perform manually into clear requirements Engineering can build from
• Define business rules, inputs, outputs, dependencies, and exception handling
• Ensure workflows are well-documented and testable
Required Qualifications
• Background in QA or software testing (manual and/or automated), with recent hands-on experience (roughly 1–3 years) as a Product Owner, Associate Product Manager, or Business Analyst on a software product
• Strong UAT experience: writing test plans and test cases from acceptance criteria, executing functional, regression, and edge-case testing, and giving release sign-off
• Experience writing detailed user stories and testable acceptance criteria and managing a backlog in Jira or a similar tool within an Agile/Scrum team
• At least some hands-on experience with AI products, such as working on, testing, or supporting an LLM-powered assistant, chatbot, or AI feature
• Working understanding of LLMs, including why outputs vary, common failure modes such as hallucination and inconsistency, and how to test and evaluate AI output quality
• Analytical by nature: comfortable pulling and interpreting product usage data and turning findings into clear recommendations
• Clear, structured written documentation that others can act on without a walkthrough
• Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken

• Experience evaluating conversational AI output in a structured way (prompt test sets, evaluation rubrics, regression testing for AI)
• Experience with product analytics tools (e.g., Pendo, Mixpanel, Amplitude) and basic SQL
• Experience working with distributed engineering teams across time zones
• Familiarity with property management, HOA/community association, or accounting workflows
About Us
Enumerate is a leader in the property management space offering a robust ERP system called Central that delivers Community Accounting, Management, Communications, Engagement, and Reporting all on one easy-to-use platform. It is the most comprehensive solution for property management, powerful enough to support large scale Property Managers, yet easy enough for Self-Management Associations.

Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.
Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!
THE OPPORTUNITY
We are hiring a Analytics Engineer (AI) to our Marketing team in Brazil!
The Analytics Engineer (AI) is an embedded analyst position, a hybrid role combining data engineering, marketing data analysis, and applied AI skills. This individual supports the Marketing Analytics team by building and maintaining the data infrastructure that enables business teams to analyze campaigns and overall marketing performance, while also expanding that infrastructure to power AI-driven analytics tools.
You will join the Marketing Analytics team, working alongside an experienced Analytics Engineer who will be your closest technical reference. Responsibilities span data modeling, pipeline management, predictive analysis, and the design of machine-readable business context that makes AI agents accurate and trustworthy. This role collaborates closely with teams across the company (including Martech, Global Analytics, Product Development, and Sales Operations) to ensure data-driven insights effectively drive business growth.
This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.
YOUR IMPACT
• Build and maintain the marketing data layer, developing pipelines that transform raw marketing sources into dimensional models (following Medallion architecture) and delivering clean, report-ready tables for downstream analytics.
• Maintain and extend BI data models (LookML and/or dbt preferred) enriched with metadata, business context, and structured definitions that make them consumable by AI agents and natural language analytics interfaces.
• Build reusable AI skills, tools, and workflows with guidance from senior engineers, empowering analysts and stakeholders to interact with governed data through natural language interfaces.
• Establish AI quality assurance by running structured test cycles defined with the team to validate AI agent output accuracy, identify regressions, and maintain quality standards as models and data evolve.
• Support the development of statistical and predictive models for marketing funnel metrics, and help maintain and operate the attribution models that measure channel and campaign contribution.
• Ensure data reliability, governance, and documentation through continuous monitoring, data validation, adherence to responsible AI standards, and comprehensive version control in GitHub.
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including Martech, Global Analytics, Product Development, and Sales Operations—to ensure high-impact data-driven insights drive business growth.
• Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.
WHO YOU ARE
• An analytics or data engineer with solid experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a closely adjacent technical role.
• A technical problem solver with solid in-depth knowledge of Python and SQL, possessing the ability to write clean, production-grade data pipelines rather than one-off scripts.
• An engineer well-versed in modern data architecture, familiar with data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT workflows, orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar), and dimensional modeling.
• A practitioner with hands-on experience in semantic layer tools (Looker/LookML strongly preferred; Tableau, PowerBI, or similar welcome).
• A curious builder with hands-on experience in applied AI, including LLMs and agentic workflows (designing agent context, AI-assisted pipeline development, or LLM-based production tools).
• A clear, collaborative communicator who enjoys working across both technical and non-technical stakeholders and is fluent in English to collaborate within a globally distributed team.
• An analytical thinker with nice-to-have exposure to AI agent context design (glossaries, structured behavioral rules) and marketing analytics domain knowledge (funnels, attribution, CRM, growth).
We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in SQL, Python, and hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic workflows are mandatory requirements.
WHAT WE OFFER YOU
With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.
Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!
Our benefits include:
WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.
WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.
HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.
FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.
FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.
PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!
PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.
CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.
CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.
Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!
Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub
We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.
Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.
Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

title: Platform Engineer - Compute
description:
## About the Role
We are seeking a platform engineer to join our Compute team. This team owns the critical systems that power project provisioning, scaling, and the compute that our users rely on every day.
You’ll work on the core platform that ensures Supabase can seamlessly scale
across multiple regions, handle high-volume workloads, and provide
low-latency, highly available compute services.
You'll design, build, and operate systems that are both robust and highly
automated — enabling us to provision new projects reliably at scale,
optimize resource utilization, and deliver a seamless experience to the
millions of databases which we manage.
## What You’ll Be Responsible For:
Help build and maintain the Supabase Cloud offering;
Design and implement systems to provision, scale, and manage the multi-region compute workloads powering Supabase projects;
Own the full lifecycle of compute orchestration: project creation, warm pools, autoscaling, resizing, and resource optimization;
Improve automation and observability across the compute stack to ensure high availability and performance;
Improve our system architecture to reduce costs while balancing security, reliability, and performance;
Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams to help leverage compute as a core platform offering;
Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews;
Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform.
## You Might Be A Good Fit If You:
Have strong software engineering skills (Go and Typescript required);
Experience building and operating cloud infrastructure or distributed systems at scale;
Have 5+ years experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS required, additional experience with GCP and Azure is a plus) - particularly compute, networking, and storage services;
Have 3+ years experience working with building custom Kubernetes controllers, and operating large-scale (tens-to-hundreds of thousands of pods) clusters;
Are knowledgable about networking and multi-region infrastructure design;
Are familiar with Postgres;
Have experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (Pulumi highly preferred, Terraform/CDK etc acceptable)
Have experience working with QEMU, KVM, and NAS is a plus;
Have experience with being part of on-call rotations for large production system;
## What We Offer
Fully Remote
We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.
ESOP
Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
Tech Allowance
Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.
Health Benefits
Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.
Annual Off-Sites
Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.
Flexible Work
We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
Professional Development
Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
## About the Team
Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.
~400 team members
60+ countries
20+ languages spoken
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)
540,000+ community members
We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Software Engineer II (Frontend)
description:
AMS (Athlete Management System) is a core product in the Teamworks Performance suite, used by elite sports organizations and high-performance military programs as their single source of truth for physical performance data, medical records, and athlete readiness. We're investing seriously in modernizing the platform, and we're growing the team with a frontend engineer who can take real ownership of the React layer as we build the next generation of AMS.
In this role, you'll be the primary frontend engineer on AMS, building the interactive, data-intensive interfaces that coaches, trainers, and performance staff rely on every day. You'll work closely with backend engineering and design to translate complex data workflows into fast, reliable UI, with real scope and a clear technical direction from day one.
## The Role
Own the AMS frontend end to end, building and shipping React and TypeScript features from design through production
Build complex, data-intensive components including interactive grids, forms, dashboards, and widgets that handle large datasets efficiently using AG Grid
Implement and maintain form-building functionality using SurveyJS, and manage application state using React Context or Zustand
Integrate frontend components with RESTful APIs and Tanstack Query, partnering with our backend team to keep data flows performant and reliable
Collaborate with design and backend engineering to deliver intuitive, accessible, and responsive user experiences
Contribute to code reviews and Agile ceremonies with our AMS team
## What We're Looking For
## What You Must Bring
3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience with strong expertise in React and TypeScript
Proven experience building complex, data-driven UI components including grids, forms, and dashboards in production applications
Experience integrating RESTful APIs into frontend applications with a solid understanding of async data fetching patterns
Working knowledge of modern build tooling including RsPack and pnpm, with experience shipping in CI/CD environments
Ability to work effectively across large timezone gaps, with regular overlap with our Australia-based team
US citizenship, with willingness to pursue security clearance in the future given AMS supports military and government performance programs
## Even Better If
You're familiar with visualization libraries like Chart.js
You have a background in performance-driven applications in sports tech, health, or military/tactical environments
You have experience working outside pure frontend, such as devops, testing, or backend
You have some Java background or prior experience working alongside backend Java teams
## Why This Role
AMS is a mission-critical product trusted by elite sports organizations and military programs around the world, and the frontend work ahead has real scope and real stakes. You'll have clear ownership over a layer of the product that directly shapes how coaches and performance staff do their jobs every day, on a focused team with a clear modernization roadmap.
This role is not eligible for sponsorship at this time.
Please submit your application through this posting only. We're unable to review applications or resumes sent via email, LinkedIn, or other channels.
To all recruitment agencies: Teamworks does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Teamworks employees or any other organization location. Teamworks is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
## About Teamworks
We're the Operating System for Sports™, powering 7,000+ organizations worldwide, from collegiate programs to every major pro league. Founded in 2006, we've evolved from a messaging tool for college football into the leading sports tech platform, with 600+ global teammates building the future of sports tech. Our solutions span Personnel, Coaching, Performance, Operations, and Intelligence - helping teams recruit smarter, train better, stay compliant, and win.
Teamworks is an equal opportunity employer - if you live our core values every day and are honest, hardworking, humble, committed, innovative, and an all-around exceptional person, you'll thrive at Teamworks. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and take affirmative action to not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, promotion, termination, compensation, benefits, and training. Teamworks is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email talent@teamworks.com.

title: Data Science Extern
description:
## Who are we and why should you join us?
BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.
As a Data Science Extern at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.
## What are we looking for?
BetterHelp is looking for a Data Science Extern to help us scale and increase our impact. You will use data to drive insight into the product and business. The ideal candidate would have experience/exposure to analyzing large and complex data sets related to web products. You'll be doing plenty of data wrangling and post-hoc analysis, both to support product improvements, marketing efficiency, and business decisions.
## What will you do?
• Language Model Optimization: Engage in the refinement and enhancement of language models, including fine-tuning and retraining to meet specific requirements.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Actively collaborate with the product and development teams to conceptualize and design effective machine learning models and algorithms tailored to our products' needs.
• Product Enhancement Partnership: Work closely with product managers, initiating and implementing proactive strategies to elevate the functionality and user experience of our products.
• Data Handling Expertise: Handle extensive text data, demonstrating proficiency in managing, analyzing, and deriving insights from large datasets.
• Coding for Production: Develop and maintain production-ready code, ensuring robustness and efficiency. Collaborate with the DevOps and ML-Ops teams to integrate machine learning models seamlessly into production environments.
• Database Proficiency: Write and optimize SQL queries, showcasing your ability to interact with and manipulate databases effectively.
• Team Dynamics and Impact: Thrive in a team-oriented environment, contributing positively to the team spirit. Enjoy a fun and dynamic work culture while taking pride in developing a world-class product that significantly impacts people's lives
## What will you NOT do?
• You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.
• You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do.
• You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!
• You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.
## Can I work remotely?
Yes. We operate on PST and candidates in any time zone are welcome to apply. We ask employees to travel to our San Jose, CA office up to three times per year plus one company-wide offsite to collaborate in person and strengthen working relationships. Travel expenses are covered and reasonable accommodations are made for those under unique circumstances who cannot travel.
## Requirements
• Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a PhD program in a quantitative discipline such as Computer Science/Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics,Operations Research, or Engineering
• Completed coursework in NLP and LLM
• Deep understanding of neural networks and deep learning and generative AI
• Familiarity with reinforcement learning
• Experience building predictive models and causal inference models
• Familiarity with generative AI
• Experience analyzing large and complex data sets
• Experience using tools like Pytorch(preferably) or Tensorflow
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and communicate technical ideas to non-technical audiences
## Benefits
• Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company
• Competitive compensation
• Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)
• Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage
• 401k benefits with employer matching contribution
• The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love
• Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive
• An awesome community of co-workers
The base salary range for this position is $40 - $60/hr. Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable to all full-time positions.
At BetterHelp we thrive on difference and individuality, and as part of the Teladoc Health family, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Simulation & SIL Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
About the role:
As part of our growing Test & Integration team, you will develop simulation and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) infrastructure to support the integration and verification of our unmanned systems across Air, Land, and sea domains.
As a Simulation & SIL Infrastructure Engineer, you will design, integrate, and maintain reliable virtual system environments. You will bring together embedded software, vehicle models, simulated sensors and actuators, and communication interfaces to enable realistic and reproducible system execution.
You will work closely with software developers, simulation engineers, system test engineers, and test automation engineers to make these environments accessible for development and continuous automated verification.
By providing robust and scalable simulation infrastructure, you will support Quantum Systems in delivering high-quality unmanned systems.
## What is your Day to Day Mission:
Design, develop, and maintain modular SIL infrastructure that can be reused across platforms and domains.
Integrate embedded software with vehicle, sensor, actuator, and environmental simulations, developing and adapting models using MATLAB and Simulink.
Implement simulation adapters, software interfaces, and supporting services using C++ and Python.
Automate the deployment, configuration, and startup of reproducible SIL environments using Docker, Linux, and version-controlled configurations.
Integrate SIL environments into CI/CD pipelines and provide interfaces for automated testing with Robot Framework and comparable tools.
Investigate integration and simulation issues, collaborating with development and HIL teams to support consistent behavior across virtual and physical environments.
## What you bring to the team:
A degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mechatronics, aerospace engineering, robotics, or a related field, or an equivalent practical qualification.
At least 3 years of experience in simulation, SIL infrastructure, embedded software integration, or a similar role.
Strong C++ programming skills and practical experience with Python.
Experience with MATLAB and Simulink for simulation model development and integration.
A good understanding of Linux, networking, and software interfaces.
Experience with Docker, Git, build systems, configuration management, and CI/CD pipelines, ideally GitHub Actions.
Strong analytical and debugging skills, with a structured approach to complex integration problems.
Experience with vehicle dynamics, sensor simulation, real-time systems, or SIL/HIL integration is a plus.
Familiarity with Robot Framework or comparable test automation frameworks is advantageous.
Experience in aerospace, defense, or safety-relevant development environments is a plus.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
A proactive, organized, and collaborative mindset, with the ability to manage multiple assignments.
Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.
## Why Quantum-Systems:
We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.
We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.
We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.
We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.
## Our benefits:
Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.
Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.
Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.
Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.
Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.
Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.
Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.
Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.
Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.
## About us:
Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.
## Our commitment:
We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.
At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

  • Architecture Modulaire & Design de SDK : Concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture Kotlin découplée et évolutive, permettant d'ajouter de nouveaux types de produits sans réécrire le cœur du système..

  • onnectivité Hybride & IoT : Maîtriser le stack Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) sous Android (gestion des cycles de vie, scans, reconnexions, spécificités constructeurs/ROMs) pour le local, et le MQTT/REST pour la communication Cloud

  • Développement d'une "Test App" : 

    • Développer et maintenir une application de test dédiée (Jetpack Compose).

    • Permettre aux QA de valider les fonctionnalités du SDK en isolation.

    • Intégrer des outils de simulation (mocking) pour tester les cas d'erreurs hardware difficiles à reproduire en réel 

  • Abstraction (L'Art du SDK Android) : Créer des API publiques simples et idiomatiques (Kotlin Coroutines / Flow) pour masquer la complexité des machines d'états hardware aux applications utilisatrices.

 

STACK TECHNIQUE

    • Langage : Kotlin (100%)

    • Asynchronisme : Coroutines, StateFlow / SharedFlow

    • Connectivité / IoT : Android BLE Stack, MQTT (ex: Paho/HiveMQ), AWS IoT Core, REST / WebSockets

    • UI (Test App) : Jetpack Compose

    • Architecture & Injection : Clean Architecture, Dependency Injection (Hilt / Koin)

    • Outillage / CI-CD : Gradle (Build Logic / Version Catalogs), Git, CI/CD pipelines pour publication de SDK/AAR.

CE DONT TU AS BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

  • Tu es un·e expert·e Kotlin / Android avec une vraie vision "Plateforme / SDK" (tu penses bibliothèque/AAR recontextualisable avant de penser écran/UI).
  • Tu maîtrises le BLE sous Android et connais ses pièges (permissions, restrictions arrière-plan, variations selon les versions d'OS/constructeurs), et tu es à l'aise avec les protocoles réseau temps réel (MQTT).
  • Tu as une solide expérience en architecture logicielle (Design Patterns, Modularité, Injection de dépendances).
  • Tu es basé à Lille, prêt à tester ton code sur les machines de sport à 50m de ton bureau.
  • Une appétence forte pour le travail en équipe et une culture du partage.
  • Un intérêt pour l’impact du sport sur le développement personnel et collectif
  • L’envie de rejoindre une entreprise engagée dans le Tech4Good et l’innovation responsable.

 

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?

Chez Decathlon, nous mettons un point d’honneur à offrir un cadre de travail épanouissant et motivant.

  • Organisation de travail hybride (2 jours de télétravail par semaine);
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac, Windows, ou Chromebooks) ;

🚀 Un environnement de travail stimulant : entreprise certifiée Great Place to Work et Happy Trainees.
💰 Des avantages attractifs (après 3 mois d’ancienneté) :

  • Primes mensuelles, intéressement, actionnariat

  • Remboursement de 50% du titre de transport & aide à la mobilité urbaine

    ⚡ Une culture du sport et du test produit : deviens ambassadeur.trice de nos innovations et rejoins nos équipes sportives internes !

Je ne connais pas le secteur du sport, ai-je ma place chez Decathlon ?

Bien sûr ! Nous recherchons avant tout des personnes passionnées et motivées, que ce soit dans leur domaine d’expertise ou par le sport en général.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. title: C++ Software Engineer, Early Careers
description:
At IMC, technology is not a department; it's at the heart of everything we do. Developed in-house, our innovative software makes millions of trading decisions daily, and we win by making better and faster decisions than our competition.

IMC's Amsterdam-based C++ Execution development teams work on software that sits directly in the latency-critical loop of our technology stack and touches every part of our organisation. We connect IMC to exchanges around the world, process massive volumes of market data in real time, execute complex trading algorithms, and integrate advanced hardware solutions where software alone isn't fast enough.

Your Core Responsibilities

As a software engineer, you'll work in multidisciplinary teams alongside other engineers, traders, researchers, and quants, both locally and across our global offices, taking ownership of end-to-end product development, from requirements gathering to production. You'll write reliable, high-performance software while balancing time to production with quality and testability. Advanced automated testing lets us deploy to production daily. Within a complex landscape of varying systems and technologies, you'll be constantly challenged to consider trade-offs between latency, throughput, simplicity, scalability and maintainability.

  • Building and maintaining the systems that connect IMC to exchanges: parsing market data feed, managing order entry, and keeping us fast and reliable on the path where latency counts.

  • Implementing and optimising execution logic in close collaboration with traders and quants, translating trading ideas into production code.

  • Working with our hardware teams to integrate FPGA-based systems and low-latency network solutions into our trading stack.

  • Measuring, profiling and improving the performance of our systems.

  • Developing expertise across the entire software development lifecycle, learning from experienced engineers along the way.

Your Skills and Experience

  • 2-3 years of full-time professional work experience post-graduation 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field

  • Strong knowledge of algorithms and data structures

  • Solid programming skills in modern C++ (C++17 or later)

  • An interest in how software actually runs on hardware: memory, caches, networking

  • A high degree of flexibility and adaptability: willing and able to deal with uncertainty and ambiguity in a rapidly evolving environment

  • Ability to solve problems creatively and proactively

  • Curiosity and a willingness to learn. Interest in financial markets; previous knowledge is not required.

About Us

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

title: Afstudeerstage AI Adoption
description:
Wil jij helpen om AI van technologie naar dagelijks werk te brengen?
Bij HG geloven we dat technologie mensen sterker maakt. Daarom hebben we de afgelopen periode een stevig fundament gelegd voor AI binnen onze organisatie. Microsoft Copilot is geïntroduceerd, er zijn verschillende AI-initiatieven gestart en steeds meer collega’s ontdekken wat AI voor hun werk kan betekenen.
De volgende stap is opschalen. Want AI beschikbaar maken is één ding. Zorgen dat mensen het daadwerkelijk goed gebruiken, er nieuwe vaardigheden mee ontwikkelen en hun manier van werken aanpassen, is waar de echte transformatie plaatsvindt.
Als afstudeerstagiair AI Adoption help je ons om die volgende stap te zetten.
Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, initiatief en nieuwsgierigheid centraal staan. Je begint dus niet vanaf nul. Je bouwt verder op wat er al staat en helpt ons te ontdekken welke aanpak nodig is om AI-adoptie verder te versnellen.
Je combineert onderzoek met praktijk. Je analyseert hoe AI wordt gebruikt, vertaalt data naar concrete acties, ontwikkelt en geeft trainingen voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus en helpt collega’s om AI steeds beter toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werk.
De exacte onderzoeksopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en afstudeereisen.
HG is een compacte, snelgroeiende en internationale organisatie waar je direct de impact van je werk ziet. Dit vraagt om eigenaarschap, initiatief en een pragmatische, resultaatgerichte houding. De cultuur is open en stimuleert het delen van ideeën, constructieve samenwerking en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Alles wat we doen is gebaseerd op onze kernwaarden: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.
Wat ga je doen?
Binnen HG zijn de eerste stappen in AI-adoptie al gezet. Er is dus een fundament om op voort te bouwen. Tijdens jouw stage help je ons om naar brede, structurele adoptie te gaan.
Concreet ga je onder andere:
Praktische en inspirerende Copilot-demo’s geven aan verschillende groepen medewerkers.
Bestaande adoptiedata analyseren en vertalen naar inzichten en concrete acties om gebruik en impact te vergroten.
Onderzoeken waar adoptie achterblijft en welke interventies kunnen helpen om medewerkers verder te brengen.
AI-trainingsprogramma’s ontwerpen en uitvoeren voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus, van collega’s die net beginnen tot ervaren gebruikers.
Trainingen, workshops, oefeningen en praktische hulpmiddelen ontwikkelen waarmee medewerkers AI direct in hun eigen werk kunnen toepassen.
De Copilot Academy op ons intranet verder ontwikkelen en actueel en relevant houden.
Medewerkers meenemen in de bredere AI-transformatie en concreet maken wat AI voor hun eigen werkzaamheden betekent.
Het AI Champions-programma ondersteunen en verder helpen ontwikkelen.
Feedback en behoeften van medewerkers ophalen en vertalen naar verbeteringen in trainingen, communicatie en andere adoptie-initiatieven.
Onderzoeken welke activiteiten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan meer gebruik, betere AI-vaardigheden en waarde voor de organisatie.
Jouw onderzoek en werkzaamheden helpen HG om AI niet alleen beschikbaar te maken, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van de dagelijkse manier van werken.
Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met onze AI Transformation Lead en hebt veel contact met collega’s uit verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van zowel de menselijke als bedrijfskundige kant van AI-transformatie.
Omdat HG actief is in meer dan 45 landen, werk je bovendien in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende functies, perspectieven en niveaus van AI-volwassenheid samenkomen.
“We beginnen bij HG niet meer vanaf nul met AI. Er ligt een fundament en steeds meer collega’s werken ermee. De interessante vraag is nu: hoe zorgen we dat AI voor veel meer mensen écht onderdeel wordt van hun dagelijkse werk? Ik zoek iemand die het leuk vindt om daar samen met mij de volgende stap in te zetten.”
– Els Marchal, AI Transformation Lead
Wie ben je?
Je volgt een relevante hbo-opleiding, zoals Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, ICT, Business Informatics, Data & Business, Human Resource Management, Learning & Development, Communicatie of vergelijkbaar.
Je hebt interesse in AI én de manier waarop mensen nieuwe technologie adopteren.
Je vindt het leuk om voor groepen te staan en anderen iets nieuws te leren.
Je kunt complexe onderwerpen op een eenvoudige en praktische manier uitleggen.
Je werkt zelfstandig en gestructureerd.
Je bent nieuwsgierig en stelt kritische vragen.
Je vindt het interessant om data te analyseren en inzichten te vertalen naar concrete acties.
Je kunt goed schakelen tussen verschillende doelgroepen en niveaus van AI-ervaring.
Je vindt het leuk om trainingen, materialen en nieuwe manieren van leren te ontwikkelen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Je hebt zelf trainingen en demo’s gegeven, met echte adoptiedata gewerkt en gezien wat ervoor nodig is om medewerkers daadwerkelijk mee te krijgen in een AI-transformatie.

Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Almere zetten wij ons dagelijks in voor superioriteit, innovatie, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid. Met een sterke aanwezigheid in Europa en daarbuiten blijven wij continu investeren om een nog grotere impact te maken.

You decide what must be tested. Our QA Automation & Pipeline Engineer builds the framework to run it, and you test directly wherever automation isn't in place yet. The engineers own the software; you own the confidence that it works.
## What You'll Do
Own test strategy, test design, and QA execution across AURA, the mobile app, cloud services, and internal tooling.
Test frontend and UI behavior, backend and API correctness, integrations, and end-to-end flows on web and mobile.
Set up automated regression for the weekly release, together with the QA Automation & Pipeline Engineer.
Build contract tests that confirm REFILL+ and Aquablu BOLD telemetry lands correctly in our central database.
Test user roles and permissions: who can see which pages and who can create, change, or delete what.
Cover authentication, data handling, and GDPR-relevant flows.
You'll start with AURA, then extend QA to the mobile app, cloud services, and internal tooling as they scale.
## What You Bring
2 to 4 years in software or full-stack QA experience across web and mobile, from UI to APIs and integrations.
Experience owning QA for a live web platform that ships continuously.
Hands-on data-pipeline and contract testing, following data from its source to the screen.
Awareness of security, access-control, and GDPR testing for digital products.
Experience working with a test-automation engineer, and the skill to test directly where automation isn't there yet.
A pragmatic, risk-weighted approach, and the habit of using AI tools every day.
## Nice to have
A background in connected-device or device-to-cloud products, experience setting up a QA practice, or exposure to identity and data-privacy testing sets you apart.
